items.subject: a crowded 1961 Madrid ballroom of young Spanish couples in their twenties, slim dark-haired men in narrow dark suits and women in knee-length full-skirted dresses, seen as a sea of turning figures
items.action: couples glide across the parquet under the chandeliers as a small orchestra plays, one young Spanish man in his late twenties stepping toward a mid-20s woman standing near the wall
items.gaze_interaction: the man's face turned toward the woman beside the wall, her shoulders eased back and chin lifted, most dancers seen from behind or in profile
items.setting: grand belle-époque ballroom of a Madrid arts club, September 1961, tall mirrored walls, gilded mouldings, marble columns, a velvet-draped stage with a small dance orchestra
items.color_palette: warm chandelier gold, cream plaster, dark suit charcoal, rose and pale blue dresses, polished walnut parquet
items.props_detail: a glowing crystal chandelier reflected in the floor-to-ceiling mirrors above the turning couples
items.camera_angle: slightly high angle from the balcony edge
items.lighting: warm tungsten chandelier glow with soft fill from wall sconces
items.mood: calm warmth, slow turning bodies, golden light pooling on the parquet, a pair of figures paused near the wall while the room keeps moving
items.narration_anchor: Dieciséis de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y uno. En el salón de baile del Círculo de Bellas Artes de Madrid, Daniel Écija conoce a María Bernal.

items.subject: a young Spanish couple in their mid-to-late twenties, slim dark-haired groom in a narrow dark suit and a petite bride in a simple white dress with a short veil, among a small cluster of family
items.action: the couple descends the stone steps of a Madrid parish church after the Thursday wedding, a few relatives tossing rice from the top step
items.gaze_interaction: the bride's arm linked tight through the groom's, both faces turned toward the street below, relatives seen from behind on the steps
items.setting: stone façade and steps of a modest Madrid parish church, 20 September 1962, a black mid-century taxi waiting at the kerb, narrow street of balconied apartment blocks
items.color_palette: pale September morning gold, grey granite, white dress, dark suit charcoal, ochre plaster façades
items.props_detail: a small bouquet of white flowers held against the bride's dress as rice scatters on the stone steps
items.lighting: clear September morning sunlight, soft shadow under the church portal
items.mood: steady morning light on stone, a couple moving down the steps pressed together, scattered rice catching the sun
items.narration_anchor: Un año después se casan: el jueves veinte de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y dos.

items.subject: hundreds of Spanish migrant families, working-class men in worn jackets and flat caps, women in headscarves and cotton dresses, filling a Mediterranean quay beside a white 1960s passenger liner
items.action: the crowd files up the gangways with cardboard suitcases and rope-tied bundles while others wave from the quay
items.gaze_interaction: faces turned up toward the ship's high white hull, most figures read from behind, a few standing still beside their luggage
items.setting: Málaga harbour quay, late September 1962, a tall white migrant liner with a single funnel, cranes and bollards, the Mediterranean behind
items.color_palette: white hull, rust-stained quay concrete, faded brown and grey coats, deep Mediterranean blue, warm sunlit stone
items.props_detail: a battered cardboard suitcase bound with rope resting at the foot of the gangway
items.camera_angle: high angle from a crane platform over the quay
items.lighting: bright Mediterranean late-afternoon sun, long shadows across the quay
items.mood: a mass of small figures against the great white hull, bundles on shoulders, slow movement toward the gangways under hard southern light
items.narration_anchor: Cuatro días más tarde ya están en el barco. Van a Australia con el acuerdo migratorio por el que pasaron cerca de ocho mil españoles.

items.subject: a young Spanish couple in their mid-twenties, small at the stern rail of a crowded migrant liner, the slim man in shirtsleeves and the petite woman in a cotton dress and cardigan
items.action: they stand pressed shoulder to shoulder at the rail as the ship pulls away, the Spanish coast thinning into haze behind them
items.gaze_interaction: both seen from behind, faces turned toward the open sea ahead, her hand hooked into the crook of his arm
items.setting: open stern deck of a 1960s passenger liner, lifeboats in davits, deck chairs, the wake spreading over the Mediterranean
items.color_palette: white painted steel, sun-bleached teak deck, pale blue sea, haze-grey horizon, faded cotton pastels
items.props_detail: a single orange cork lifebuoy fixed to the rail beside the couple
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the upper deck behind them
items.lighting: bright overcast sea light, flat and high
items.mood: two figures small against the wide wake, bodies leaning together, the coastline dissolving into haze
items.narration_anchor: De Wittenoom no saben nada; saben que hay trabajo y que van juntos.

items.subject: a petite Spanish woman in her mid-twenties in a sun-faded cotton dress, dark hair pinned back, and her late-20s husband, a slim wiry Spanish man in a rolled-sleeve shirt
items.action: she walks along the ship's side deck tucked close against his side, her shoulder under his arm, matching his step
items.gaze_interaction: seen in three-quarter profile, her face turned up toward him, his face forward along the deck, their bodies touching from shoulder to hip
items.setting: narrow side promenade of a 1960s migrant liner, riveted white bulkhead, round portholes, deck rail and sea beyond
items.color_palette: white steel, teak brown, salt-grey rail, faded floral cotton, bright sea blue
items.props_detail: a folded cardigan clutched against her chest with a small leather handbag
items.lighting: bright overcast sea light, soft bounce from the white bulkhead
items.mood: two bodies walking as one shape along the rail, her weight leaned into him, soft even light on faded cotton
items.narration_anchor: «Iba pegadita a mi marido, como una niña», recuerda su mujer.

items.subject: two young Spanish migrant couples in their twenties and thirties, working-class Madrid families in dusty mid-century clothes, gathered on the shaded veranda of a corrugated-iron house
items.action: they share a meal at a plank table on the veranda as dust drifts across the red yard in the late sun
items.gaze_interaction: figures seen mostly from behind and in profile around the table, one woman leaning toward the other, a man resting his forearm on the table
items.setting: veranda of a simple corrugated-iron and timber house in Wittenoom, 1962, the town active, red dirt yard, a mid-century truck parked beyond, dusty blue sky
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, rust and silver corrugated iron, sun-faded blue and khaki clothing, dusty pale sky
items.props_detail: an enamel jug and tin mugs on the plank table catching the low sun
items.lighting: low golden hour sun raking across the veranda through fine dust haze
items.mood: four figures leaned toward each other around one table, warm light on tin and timber, dust hanging gold in the air
items.narration_anchor: Con el tiempo se hicieron amigos íntimos de otra pareja, Milagros Barroso y Ramón de Juan. Esa familia madrileña había hecho el mismo viaje un mes antes.

items.subject: a small Spanish boy of about eight, thin, dark-haired, in a short-sleeved shirt and shorts, alone at the rail of a crowded migrant liner's sun deck
items.action: he leans on the lower rail with his shirt stuck to his back in the heat, the deck behind him crowded with resting adults
items.gaze_interaction: seen from behind, face turned toward the flat glaring sea, adults behind him slumped in deck chairs read as shapes
items.setting: open sun deck of a 1960s migrant liner in tropical heat, canvas awnings, deck chairs, a glassy sea under a white sky
items.color_palette: bleached white steel, canvas cream, glare-white sky, pale aquamarine sea, sweat-darkened cotton
items.props_detail: a damp cloth cap hung on the rail beside the boy
items.lighting: harsh tropical midday sun, hard overhead shadows, heat haze on the horizon
items.mood: a small figure against a white glare, sweat-stuck shirt, adults slumped motionless under awnings
items.narration_anchor: Un niño que hizo ese viaje todavía recuerda el calor.

items.subject: a thin Spanish boy of about eight in a cotton shirt and shorts among a line of Spanish migrant families climbing a ship's gangway, a working-class father carrying a bundle, a mother in a headscarf
items.action: the boy climbs the steep gangway one hand on the rope rail, the family pressed ahead and behind him in the queue
items.gaze_interaction: seen from the side and behind, the boy's face turned up toward the white hull towering above, adults' faces hidden by bundles and hat brims
items.setting: steel gangway up the side of a white migrant liner at Málaga quay, September 1962, port warehouses and cranes behind
items.color_palette: white hull, grey gangway steel, rope tan, brown and faded blue clothing, warm quay stone
items.props_detail: a string-tied cardboard suitcase carried by the father just ahead of the boy
items.camera_angle: low angle from the quay looking up the gangway
items.lighting: bright Mediterranean late-afternoon sun, long shadows across the hull
items.mood: a small body climbing between larger ones, the hull filling the sky, one hand on the rope
items.narration_anchor: Víctor Calvo era un niño cuando subió a ese barco.

items.subject: a white 1960s migrant liner with a single funnel pulling away from the Málaga breakwater, its rails lined with hundreds of tiny Spanish figures
items.action: tugs ease the ship out past the lighthouse while hundreds on the quay wave handkerchiefs
items.gaze_interaction: the whole crowd on the quay faces the departing ship, figures read as a dense mass from behind
items.setting: Málaga harbour mouth, September 1962, breakwater and lighthouse, the cathedral and hills behind the city, cranes along the quay
items.color_palette: white hull, deep Mediterranean blue, warm ochre city, grey breakwater stone, pale gold sky
items.props_detail: a white handkerchief held high above the crowd on the quay
items.camera_angle: high angle from the harbour hill
items.lighting: bright Mediterranean late-afternoon sun, long shadows across the quay
items.mood: a great white ship small against the sea, a dense crowd shrinking on the quay, hard clear light
items.narration_anchor: «Salimos de Málaga y tardamos más de 20 días en llegar en barco a Australia», dice Calvo.

items.subject: a white migrant liner moving slowly through the Suez Canal, a narrow ribbon of water between flat sand banks, passengers crowded in the shade of its awnings
items.action: the ship creeps through the canal in blistering heat, sand stretching to the horizon on both sides, figures on deck fanning themselves
items.gaze_interaction: passengers slumped at the rails under awnings, read as small shapes, faces turned away from the glare toward the shaded deck
items.setting: Suez Canal, autumn 1962, flat desert banks, a distant palm cluster and low mud buildings, a cargo ship far ahead
items.color_palette: white hull, bleached sand ochre, glare-white sky, dull green canal water, heat-haze grey
items.props_detail: a canvas awning sagging over the packed deck, its shadow the only dark shape on the ship
items.camera_angle: high angle from the canal bank
items.lighting: harsh tropical midday sun, hard overhead shadows, heat haze on the horizon
items.mood: a ship suspended in white glare between two deserts, bodies crammed into the one strip of shade, air shimmering
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda el canal de Suez y el calor que hacía ahí, un calor que todavía lo hace resoplar cuando lo cuenta.

items.subject: a few Spanish migrant passengers, a sweat-soaked wiry father in his thirties, a mother with hair plastered to her temples, a thin eight-year-old boy, slumped on a bench in a cramped lower-deck corridor
items.action: they sag against the bulkhead as the ship rolls, the mother holding a wet cloth to the boy's neck, a tin basin at their feet
items.gaze_interaction: heads lowered and turned toward the bulkhead, the boy curled against his mother's side, the father's face hidden in the crook of his arm
items.setting: narrow lower-deck passage of a 1960s migrant liner, riveted steel, sweating paint, a single porthole showing a tilted horizon
items.color_palette: cream-painted steel gone yellow, damp grey, sweat-darkened cotton, dull brass porthole rim, sea glare
items.props_detail: a dented enamel basin on the floor beside the bench
items.camera_angle: eye-level, slightly tilted with the roll of the ship
items.lighting: harsh tropical daylight through one porthole, hot and flat on the steel
items.mood: bodies folded against sweating steel, clothes dark with sweat, the horizon tilted in the porthole
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda los mareos. Y la incertidumbre: no saber muy bien adónde iban ni cómo iban a vivir.

items.subject: a small twin-engine propeller aircraft of the early 1960s, silver and white, flying low over an endless red desert plain
items.action: the aircraft bucks through heat turbulence above red ridges and spinifex, propellers blurred, its shadow racing over the ground
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the aircraft's path toward a far dusty gorge line on the horizon
items.setting: over the Pilbara desert of Western Australia, 1962, red iron-rich plains, dry creek lines, flat-topped ranges in haze
items.color_palette: deep red earth, rust ochre, pale spinifex gold, dusty blue sky, silver aluminium
items.props_detail: the aircraft's hard shadow skimming a dry red creek bed below
items.camera_angle: high angle from above and behind the aircraft
items.lighting: harsh dusty midday sun, heat shimmer over the red plain
items.mood: a tiny machine over a vast red emptiness, heat haze bending the horizon
items.narration_anchor: Después del barco, un avión pequeño, de hélices, que se sacude durante todo el vuelo.

items.subject: a small 1960s propeller aircraft touching down on a bare dirt airstrip surfaced with tailings in the middle of a red desert plain
items.action: the aircraft rolls out trailing a huge boiling cloud of fine dust that drifts across the strip and the waiting truck
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the strip toward the dust cloud swallowing the aircraft
items.setting: Wittenoom airstrip, Pilbara, 1962, a graded dirt strip surfaced with grey-blue mine tailings, red earth all around, a corrugated-iron shed and a mid-century truck, range escarpment behind
items.color_palette: deep red earth, grey-blue tailings dust, silver aircraft, rust iron shed, dusty pale blue sky
items.props_detail: a windsock on a steel pole hanging limp inside the rolling dust cloud
items.camera_angle: low angle from the strip's edge
items.lighting: harsh dusty midday sun, light scattered white through the dust
items.mood: a vast flat emptiness, one aircraft vanishing into its own dust, the horizon lost in haze
items.narration_anchor: Aterriza en una pista en medio de una tierra muy roja, en el desierto de Pilbara, en Australia Occidental. Hay polvo por todas partes.

items.subject: a newly arrived Spanish migrant family, a wiry father in his thirties with a dust-greyed jacket, a mother in a sun-faded dress, a thin eight-year-old boy, carrying suitcases down a dusty street toward a row of simple houses
items.action: a company man in a khaki shirt and wide hat leads them along the dirt road as wind lifts fine grey-blue dust over their shoes and luggage
items.gaze_interaction: the family seen from behind, faces turned toward the houses ahead, the boy's head turned toward the dust blowing across the road
items.setting: residential street of Wittenoom in its active 1962 state, a row of small occupied houses of corrugated iron, timber frames and asbestos-cement sheet walls on stumps, the road and yards surfaced with tailings, red desert and range behind
items.color_palette: red earth, grey-blue tailings dust, silver and rust corrugated iron, faded cream asbestos-cement sheeting, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a cardboard suitcase already coated in a film of fine grey dust, carried by the father
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the road behind the family
items.lighting: harsh dusty midday sun, light scattered white through the dust
items.mood: small figures walking into a haze of dust toward tin houses, clothes already greyed, a street without shade
items.narration_anchor: Ese niño cuenta que nunca había visto tanto polvo. Los llevan a las casas: chapa, madera y uralita.

items.subject: the crocidolite mill and mine mouth in the gorge, heaps of fibrous grey-blue tailings spilling down the slope beneath a corrugated-iron processing plant
items.action: miners in dust-caked trousers and shirts push ore trucks out of a low gallery while the mill exhales a plume of fine dust into the gorge
items.gaze_interaction: workers seen from behind and at distance as silhouettes in the dust, bent low under the gallery lip
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge mine and mill, 1962, red rock gorge walls, timber headframe, corrugated-iron mill sheds, ore trucks on narrow rails
items.color_palette: deep red rock, grey-blue tailings, rust and silver iron, dust-grey khaki workwear, dusty pale sky
items.props_detail: a tipped ore truck spilling blue-grey fibrous ore at the gallery mouth
items.camera_angle: low angle from the gorge floor
items.lighting: harsh dusty midday sun, light scattered white through the dust
items.mood: bent silhouettes under a low rock lip, a plume of dust drifting over the gorge, blue-grey heaps spilling into red rock
items.narration_anchor: De esa tierra sacan crocidolita, el asbesto azul, un mineral que se paga bien porque aguanta el calor y no se gasta.

items.subject: a Spanish migrant mother in her mid-twenties in a faded cotton dress and a thin eight-year-old boy standing in the bare yard of their new corrugated-iron house, their shoes sunk in the ground cover of tailings
items.action: wind lifts a veil of fine grey-blue dust across the yard and over them as the boy crouches to scoop a handful of the ground
items.gaze_interaction: the mother's face turned toward the boy, one hand resting on his shoulder, the boy's head bent to the ground in his hands, both seen from a slight distance through the drifting dust
items.setting: backyard of an occupied Wittenoom house in 1962, corrugated iron and asbestos-cement walls, a clothesline, the yard surfaced with tailings, red desert and range beyond
items.color_palette: red earth, grey-blue tailings dust, rust and silver iron, faded cream sheeting, sun-bleached cotton, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a line of washing already streaked grey with dust above the yard
items.lighting: harsh dusty midday sun, light scattered white through the dust
items.mood: two figures small inside a haze of pale dust, a hand on a child's shoulder, washing greying on the line
items.narration_anchor: Nadie les dijo qué era el polvo. La compañía lo sabía desde hacía dieciocho años.
